race.comment: PLAN OF ATTACK (5) was thrown in the deep end on debut in Listed company and while he didn't threaten the stable must obviously have a good opinion of him.  Made a strong return here three weeks ago when missing by a head. Is sure to have come on from that and can get off the mark this time. NO NO NO NO NO (2) was no match for an impressive maiden winner when resuming but is sure to have come on from that and looks to have his share of ability. Will appreciate stretching out the extra 200m and looms the main danger. SUN IN JUNE (9) is another of the main threats in her stable debut for the Gollan camp. Had excuses on debut back in April and looks to have come back in good order, stripping fitter for a Doomben trial. Can make a bright return. LOGAN DOWNS (4) was beaten a length as a well-supported favourite at Kilcoy over this trip. Expect him to burn across from the draw and be the one they need to reel in.
